originalTitle: Eric Trump-backed defence technology company Space-Eyes to go public in $638 million SPAC deal
simplifiedContent: A company called Space-Eyes, which specializes in defense technology, is planning to become a publicly traded company through a deal worth $638 million. This is happening because Space-Eyes is merging with another company called McKinley Acquisition Corp. Eric Trump will be involved with the new company as a strategic adviser, which means he'll be providing guidance and advice. The company will focus on developing technologies that use artificial intelligence to counter drones and analyze geographic data. This deal is significant because it values the company at a large amount of money, which could indicate that investors think it has a lot of potential.

originalTitle: Federal Realty raises annual core profit forecast on strong leasing demand
simplifiedContent: Federal Realty Investment Trust, a company that owns and manages properties, has increased its expected profit for the year due to strong demand from businesses wanting to lease space. The company had a better-than-expected second quarter, with more businesses leasing space and paying higher rents. This led to an increase in the company's core funds from operations, which is a measure of its financial health. As a result, the company is now more confident in its ability to make a profit this year. This update is important because it shows that Federal Realty's business is doing well, which could be good news for investors who own its stock.

originalTitle: Sebi extends deadline till Oct-end to complete digital accessibility audits, resolve platform issues
simplifiedContent: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) has given companies more time to make their digital platforms accessible to people with disabilities. The new deadline to complete this work is October 31, 2026, which is later than the original date of April 30. This means companies have a few more months to fix any issues with their online systems. Sebi made this decision because companies were asking for more time to comply with laws that support inclusivity in financial services. This extension gives companies until July 31 to fix any remaining problems, after which they must be fully compliant by the end of October.

originalTitle: Bharat Electronics shares to be in focus on Monday as company secures  ₹847 crore order
simplifiedContent: Bharat Electronics Ltd. (BEL) has received a new order worth ₹847 crore, which may attract investors' attention on Monday. This is the company's third big order in a few months, following orders worth ₹572 crore and ₹1,081 crore in July and June, respectively. Even with these new orders, BEL's shares have been declining in value this year. This new order might be important because it could help change the direction of the company's shares. It will be interesting to see how investors react to this news on Monday.

originalTitle: Bloomberg again defers decision on including Indian government bonds in Global Aggregate Index
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening: Bloomberg, a big company that tracks investments, was thinking about adding Indian government bonds to its list of important investments, called the Global Aggregate Index. However, they decided to wait a bit longer before making a decision. This means that Indian government bonds are not yet part of this important list, which many investors use to decide where to put their money. Investors want to see how some recent changes to India's investment rules work in practice before they consider adding Indian government bonds to the list. This decision is important because it could affect how much money flows into India's economy from foreign investors.

originalTitle: Jio Financial Services declares record date to finalise eligible shareholders for FY26 final dividend
simplifiedContent: Jio Financial Services has decided to pay a final dividend of ₹0.60 per share to its shareholders for the financial year 2025-26. To be eligible for this dividend, you need to buy the company's shares before August 10, which is the set "record date". The company has also reported a significant increase in profit, with a 156% rise to ₹830 crore in the second quarter of 2026. This means the company is performing well, which might be good news for investors. If you buy the shares before August 10, you will be eligible to receive the ₹0.60 per share dividend.
